source.title: Netherweave Boots — original Thottbot 13-disenchant item-specific report
source.author: Thottbot (archived original contributor name unavailable)

quote: DEed 13 of these
notes: WotLK Classic archived item page presents uncommon cloth boots at historical item level 108. Original report enumerates 13 disenchant outcomes: seven Arcane Dust, five Greater Planar Essence and one Large Prismatic Shard. Each positive stack bin is directly transcribed; totalQuantity and castsWithDrop are sums of stated bins. Per-material zero bins are arithmetic complements of a complete 13-operation report, not observed globally empty disenchant casts. Source date, build, actual Enchanting skill, bonuses and modern Retail eligibility unknown. Do not transfer to Warmaul Legplates 24995.

source.title: Enchanted Thorium Blades — Lobo2me March 2008 final 126-DE report
source.author: Lobo2me

quote: 126 blades DEed into 153 GEE, 43 Illusion Dust and 1 LBS.
notes: Original comment dated March 6 2008 and edited March 13 2008, patch 2.3.3. Use only the final 126-operation snapshot; the same author's earlier 30, 33 and 60-blade edits are not independent cohorts. Earlier 33-blade edit reports 2 Large Brilliant Shards versus final 126 report of 1; possible distinct batches or inconsistent revisions, do not sum or assume cumulative. Historical uncommon thrown weapon item 29203 is not a confirmed disenchantable current-Retail item; MoP Classic page flags cannot be disenchanted. Actual skill and stack histograms unknown.
